title: Relationship Banking Schedule: the Share of the Payable Balance a Standing Instruction Covers
content:
The share of the payable balance covered by a standing automatic payment instruction on a card under Personal Credit Cards is read from the cardholder's Personal Checking relationship together with the card payments that have posted to that card account.

| What the records show | Coverage share |
|---|---|
| An active Premier Checking or Private Client Checking account, and at least 6 card payments posted to this card account in the last twelve months | 90 percent |
| An active checking account whose tier is neither Premier Checking nor Private Client Checking, and at least 6 card payments posted to this card account in the last twelve months | 75 percent |
| Neither of those | no adjustment to the coverage share is made |

**The two parts of each tier.** The checking holding and the payment count are required together. A cardholder holding an active Private Client Checking account whose card account shows 2 card payments in the last twelve months meets neither tier; a cardholder holding an active Access Checking account with 6 card payments meets the second.

**On the count.** The count is read as at least, so exactly 6 card payments in the last twelve months satisfies either tier's second part, and 5 satisfies neither. A cardholder with no active checking account meets neither tier.
